title: OpenCV SGBM implementation
recurrence_excerpts:
compute L_r(p, d) = C(p, d) +
             min(L_r(p-r, d),
             L_r(p-r, d-1) + P1,
             L_r(p-r, d+1) + P1,
             min_k L_r(p-r, k) + P2) - min_k L_r(p-r, k)
             where p = (x,y), r is one of the directions.
             we process all the directions at once:
             0: r=(-dx, 0)
             1: r=(-1, -dy)
